description: Land Title Settlement Dept - Elhena, Meerigama  D/S/D, Gampaha District (25/5514226)
categorisation: The gazette content exclusively concerns the formal registration and declaration of land titles for specific parcels of land under the Registration of Title Act. It includes detailed schedules listing parcel numbers, owner names, extents, and encumbrances. This falls squarely under the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category, which is defined for "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" and "Any gazette content primarily dealing with land, property, or real estate matters." The content does not involve government personnel/structure (Types 1-3) or any other specialized administrative area (Types 5-9).
